decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing went unobserved in 2020 to 2021 and faces commoditisation from cloud collaboration platforms after the pandemic, so it is falling short of aspirations, but it costs little to carry on existing voice infrastructure and the firm's expansion slack lets it stay for now.

The metro data centre network has documented adoption by financial customers and sits at the centre of the high-bandwidth data centre strategy, so it exceeds aspirations and gives no trigger for search.

Optical spectrum connectivity uses the owned fibre and fits the move to high-bandwidth, software-defined infrastructure, so management commitment stays high despite the lack of recent website evidence.
The number ordering portal is a cheap self-service tool that supports voice provisioning, though it may be absorbed into a broader digital portal.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony service in a shrinking market that has fallen below aspirations, so problemistic search points to pruning it and moving resources to cloud and software-defined services.
Direct voice network connection remains a core enterprise voice offering close to the established business, with no clear shortfall that would justify withdrawing it.
